title: Made a chill space game prototype with Three.js + AI
author: ineedthealgorithm
selftext:
Started playing around with a small space game idea for vibejam and ended up building a quick prototype in about \~30 mins using Three.js.

The idea was pretty simple: just a spaceship drifting through space with a focus on movement and atmosphere rather than heavy gameplay. From there, I started iterating a bit, added planets and asteroids, and tried to make the motion feel smoother.

Most of the assets are from Sketchfab (just basic models for now), nothing too fancy.

Here’s the initial prompt I used:

>

Still early, but it’s been interesting to see how quickly something playable can come together.

You can check it out here: [https://www.pixelfork.ai/publish/427c8525-7c10-441d-8bee-0bc9bd60a9c0](https://www.pixelfork.ai/publish/427c8525-7c10-441d-8bee-0bc9bd60a9c0)
